title: Understanding Replication
text: Think about what 4-way replication means. If each fragment is replicated $$4$$ times, how many total fragments do you have now?

title: Calculating Total Fragments
text: If you have $$800$$ fragments and each is replicated $$4$$ times, how many fragments are there in total? Try calculating $$800$$ times $$4$$.

title: Distributing Fragments
